venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Monday 11/16 (MOD MKZ; entered by MKZ; posted 12:20am ET 11/17; form date mis-typed as 11/17)** Net $1,067 vs target $771 (138.4%). Food $320; no events; comps $17.60 (1.6%; community member/investor $10, employee discount $6, industry love $1.60). 30 guests; check avg $35.55. Very chill Monday with a slow start; 12 meal deals on the night. New DJ (DJ Vibin) for Open Deck Night — new to the venue, so turnout was smaller than the previous two weeks, but the set was high energy without being out of place. Late-night pops are thinner with the sudden temperature drop and the holiday approaching. Smooth night; FOH and BOH completed cleaning duties; neighborhood regulars in. Kitchen: great ticket times. Maintenance: CO2 fixed; Auto-Chlor needs to fix the bar dishwasher. Low diet, Noon, Pathfinder, Oktoberfest, Fernet; 86 Diplomatico, Patron Silver, shorty service. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Monday 11/16 (MOD KE, Chef Amanda; entered by BT; posted 1:52am ET 11/17)** Net $866 vs target $1,000 (86.6%). Food $126; no events; comps $22.20 (2.56%). 35 guests; check avg $24.75. A sleepy Monday with a lot of dates, especially first dates. Food sales respectable and Amanda did a great job. Team spent time cleaning, with attention to hidden spots under equipment. Kitchen: smooth sailing, good sales. 86 ponies and Guinness; low pilsner. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Monday 11/16 (AM MOD Evan; PM MOD Maggie H; entered by MJH; posted 1:19am ET 11/17)** Net $7,763.99 vs target $5,525 (140.5%; form notes +$2,237). Form left the 'including Events' fields as NA, so net and food are the 'Total Net Sales' / 'Total Food Sales' figures. AM (coffee) $788.04, D&C PM $5,439.95, Garden/6A $1,536. Food $1,025.10; comps $249.45 (3.2%). 148 guests (Tock); check avg $52.46 (net/guests). AM: short and sweet mix of coffee and cocktails; cold brew ready 8am, coffee order in, well stocked. PM: the Nikka / Press Club pop-up was a hit — great drinks, lots of support, and guests shifting over from regular service to check it out; team dressed in suits. 6A: Graham and Lucas hosted another cocktail class. Kitchen: chill night, sold a lot of burgers and steaks; light prep tomorrow; 911 red beet puree, lime chantilly, ground beef; low burger portions, steaks, cocktail sauce, mignonette, chicken breast, cola onions. Break make-up complete. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.weather: Warmer than prior days but still wintry
venues.narrative: **EV — Monday 11/16 (MOD Jane, Chef Michael; entered by Thomas; posted 11:36am ET 11/17)** Net $4,264 vs target $4,368 (97.6%). Food $630, beverage $3,634; no events; comps $133.40 (3.1%). 120 guests (SevenRooms); check avg $35.53 (net/guests; form $36). Slow start, built to a fairly full room, then steady but quiet with a slightly better than expected finish; never absurdly full — the rail and T1 each turned once. Lots of older out-of-towners who love the book. 2 large parties (both in the first hour), 6 solos, 112 oysters. Top sellers: Rosalie, High Plains Drifter, Dirty Martini. Kitchen: $350 in the first 70 minutes. Door: cold evening (down to 38), no waitlist but decent flow; 9-top inside by 7pm, small wave at 10pm, last walk-in 11:45pm; many first-time groups from Texas, industry friends from The Argyle and Public. 2 no-shows (not charged). Menu count 19.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Monday 11/16 (MOD Julian, Chef Saleh; entered by Julian Catano; posted 3:29am ET 11/17)** Net $4,270 vs target $4,323 (98.8%). All Marquee ($4,270; food $1,014); Standing Room $0; no events; comps $129 (3.0%; DNLs, gifts, discounts). 97 guests; check avg $44.02. Calm, mellow start with most guests wanting the bar — bar top full before the tables. First couple of hours manageable for one server; after dinner it got busy with a full house for a while, including guests over from Mírate and Steep. Newest team member barbacked and did an amazing job. Good shift for Oyster Monday. Kitchen: one-man band shucking oysters all night. Maintenance: pests are back. 86 Contrabandista, desserts. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Monday 11/16 (MOD Jesse; entered by Jesse; posted 12:06am ET 11/17)** Net $3,983.61 (form 'Total Net Sales Including Events') vs target $6,677 (59.7%). Note: the form also lists Marquee bar / total sales of $5,179.49, higher than the net figure — the two don't reconcile and are worth confirming. Garden closed; food $455; no events; discounts $30.30 (0.8%), voids 1.5% (entry errors / 86'd items). 92 guests (43 reservations, 49 walk-ins); check avg $43.30 (net/guests; form GA $45.79, GCA $88.98). Very steady night — strong from open and an even pace throughout; most of the room full for a large part of the night without getting out of hand. Tight communication and ticket passing kept drink times down; good use of the back bar and compendium to cover multiple out-of-stock cocktails. Kitchen: pretty chill, a few tables ordering multiple plates; franks 86'd for a while; a few long ticket times, popcorn dropped to keep guests happy. Kitchen close checked. Do better: pre-bussing, preventing glassware build-up. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Maintenance: hot water heater, curtain, under-bar lights.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Monday 11/16 (AM Victoria & Shannon; PM James & Marcus; entered by Eva Zaientz; posted 11:34pm ET 11/16)** Net $3,118 vs target $4,361 (71.5%). Morning bar $1,066, evening bar $2,053; Sun Club and Hot Eye $0; no events; food $1,477; comps $122 (3.9%). 52 guests (4 AM + 48 PM OpenTable); check avg $59.96 (net/guests). Morning very slow, nothing of note. Evening had 2–4 tables at a time and only a few guests at the bar; food and drinks came out efficiently and consistently. Kitchen: slow night, on top of ticket times. No incidents. Highlight: a group at the bar enjoyed their pre-dinner drinks enough to cancel their dinner reservation elsewhere and eat here.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Monday 11/16 (MOD Curtis Hayes; entered by Alexis; posted 2:24am ET 11/17)** Net $5,088 vs target $6,411 (79.4%). Food $824; no events; comps $287.81 (form 3.5%; DK tab plus friends and family from the neighborhood). 112 guests; check avg $45.42. Fairly quiet start with few walk-ins; reservations picked up 4:15–4:30pm, then mellow but consistently paced until ~8pm; a concert letting out brought some guests but not enough to push much past $5K. Kitchen, floor and bar all ran smoothly with early cuts; host held it down. Lots of anniversaries; Daymade staff came in. Kitchen: rocked it, great staff meal. No incidents; no-shows charged.
